mapper.select: SELECT acua.ID, acua.LOGIC_DEL, acua.REC_VER, acua.TENANT_ID, acua.COST_ID, acua.USER_ID, acua.AMOUNT, acua.OPERATE_TIME, acua.ALLOC_FLAG, su.USER_NAME, su.NICK_NAME FROM account_cost_user_alloc acua LEFT JOIN sys_user su on acua.USER_ID = SU.ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND acua.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND acua.COST_ID = #{dto.costId} ORDER BY acua.ID

SELECT COLLECTED.ID, COLLECTED.USER_ID, COLLECTED.AMOUNT, U.NICK_NAME, AC.PAYMENT_TIME, AC.COST_DESC, AC.REMARK FROM account_cost_user_alloc COLLECTED LEFT JOIN SYS_USER U ON U.ID = COLLECTED.USER_ID AND COLLECTED.ALLOC_FLAG = 0 LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_COST AC ON AC.ID = COLLECTED.COST_ID WHERE COLLECTED.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND COLLECTED.ALLOC_FLAG = 0 AND AC.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY AC.PAYMENT_TIME DESC

SELECT ALLOCATED.ID, ALLOCATED.USER_ID, ALLOCATED.AMOUNT, AC.USER_ID AS PAYEE_USER_ID, U.NICK_NAME AS PAYEE_NICK_NAME, AC.PAYMENT_TIME, AC.COST_DESC, AC.REMARK FROM account_cost_user_alloc ALLOCATED LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_COST AC ON AC.ID = ALLOCATED.COST_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER U ON U.ID = AC.USER_ID where ALLOCATED.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND ALLOCATED.ALLOC_FLAG = 0 AND ALLOCATED.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY AC.PAYMENT_TIME DESC
